objective: Reconcile all current Nov17/Nov18 owner-requested BUKLOD Android fixes into one staging-only, source-verified, fail-closed RC without overwriting current main, ads, media or formation reporting.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main SOURCE commit d23cd882f7d34c4bca3a110dadd04ee4cb2240a9 was read, and the current RC branch compared against it with zero missing commits; all required #916/#917/#923/#918/#922/#924 heads were independently compared as ancestors of the RC. This verifies repository SOURCE ancestry only, NOT the live production baseline. Historical Nov17 staging PR #900 recorded source 730c811cda97d106339f14fae04fb4b8890b0ed2 on runtime 1.3.2; no current device/OTA/runtime/fill has been physically verified by owner request. Weak-signal login component #934 source was compared to the frozen RC and merged at 0c464ec12c479664934a0e0d139b6a3a0079f5a9; merge is source-only, not runtime or OTA verification.
chosenApproach: Create a single RC integration branch from latest main; merge source stacks #916-#917-#923 together, #918 Android instant tabs, #922 forward-port of #919 Henry translation, and #924 scoped video rendering, each against the same RC. Preserve component scope manifests and run consolidated exact-source CI, without automatic release. Add verified isolated #934 for weak-signal login progress, same-user profile snapshot reconciliation, and missing-profile versus transport-failure differentiation; no auth bypass.
selectionRationale: Dedicated RC branch avoids rewriting production/main, preserves formation migrations and source provenance, and isolates overlapping video/player changes. No new native dependencies, ads policy or backend writes. OTA promotion remains gated on immutable artifact and runtime compatibility. The login-only branch had exact-head Engineering Accountability and Main Integration QA success before merging into this staging-only RC.

Run changed focused tests and native-independent AdMob/nav/media source regression gates, TypeScript, web compatibility export and protected source tests
Preserve Android Hermes 1.3.2 compatibility and separate native ML Kit APK requirement; no native dependency/source changes
Do not publish staging/production until exact artifact & manifest verified through approved release path; actual device testing intentionally not claimed
Any failing ad load/fill, offscreen lifecycle, first-view ad warmup or navigation gate blocks OTA
Run exact cumulative RC Node/TypeScript/ad/nav regression checks after adding #934; confirmed missing profile must invalidate cached UI identity; weak signal must not force onboarding
Confirm staging OTA artifact and AdMob first-view/instant-navigation gates before any release; PR merge is source-only, not a deployment
alternativeApproaches: Merge each feature directly into production main (rejected because it risks unrelated incomplete DEV changes reaching production source)
Publish source without a reproducible RC and mandatory CI (rejected because ad/navigation/video regressions previously occurred)
Copy entire stale branch over latest main (rejected because this can drop Formation SQL, Wall edits and current media fixes)
